summary: Implemented and hardened a bounded public privacy scan that reuses the existing fail-closed privacy-closure harness, scans sanitized portfolio/MP10 returns plus the gh-pages public projection, never emits matched values, and persists CI evidence durably. Final CI run 36562171344 scanned 5,351 text files / 28,529,016 bytes and found zero high-confidence secret/private-packet findings.
tests: PASS existing privacy-closure adversarial harness including transcript, signed-query, authorization, private-packet, email and phone fail-closed controls.
PASS bounded scan scopes: 289 portfolio RETURN files, 10 MP10 RETURN files, 5,052 gh-pages public text files.
PASS 5,351 files / 28,529,016 bytes scanned with no matched value emitted to durable evidence.
PASS authorization metadata key alone is not treated as a leak outside the stricter public-closure-pack contract; literal Bearer/token/secret patterns still fail.
PASS zero high-confidence public secret, signed-token, raw private-packet or attachment-token findings.
truth_boundary: This verifies the bounded scanned public/sanitized surfaces and high-confidence patterns. It does not certify unscanned private stores or prove G09 recovery/storage as a whole.
